# Security policy

Please report security vulnerabilities in OperaLibre privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/DonovanMontoya/OperaLibre/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or pull request, and do not disclose the problem
publicly until it has been investigated and a fix is available.

Include the affected version, your deployment mode, steps to reproduce, and the
impact you observed. Only the latest release receives security fixes.

For hardening a server you run, see [Deployment](../docs/deployment.md) and
[Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
